_comment: Add events here that cannot be fetched automatically (e.g. Bristol Hippodrome musicals).

_format.name: required — event title
_format.url: required — link to book or get more info
_format.cost: optional — e.g. '£15 - £45' or 'Free'. Defaults to 'Price TBA'
_format.image: optional — URL of a poster or image
